name: paprika3d
description: The toolset that makes your coding agent a better three.js developer: it sees, plays, inspects, builds and speeds up the three.js, React Three Fiber and WebGL pages it writes, in headless Chrome on a paused, seeded clock. What is on screen and what never appears, keys in and state out, mesh stats, procedural geometry, frame-time budgets with an optimizer, and a check after every edit.
